addons.name: Cry of Fear Glock
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua (model and sounds: Team Psykskallar, Cry of Fear)
addons.description: Glock 19 with slide lock, empty reloads and iron sights. Models and sounds are inside this addon. Requires Half-Life: Lua addon asset mounting. !give weapon_cof_glock

addons.name: Cry of Fear vehicle pack
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: Aud, Vari, Foretag, police car and fire engine, with matching physical wheels. Imports models from your local Cry of Fear installation.

addons.name: Fieldrunner utility van
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: An original six-seat van with a detailed cabin, custom wheels, suspension, running and brake lamps, and a two-tone horn.

addons.name: First-person body
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: See your own body and legs in first person: walks, runs, crouches, jumps and turns in place, with the head hidden and the arms hidden while you hold a weapon. Settings in lua_settings.
